claims.claim: Prado Jeep front grill and tailight in working condition available in GRA Ikeja.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show Honda-branded grille badge (stylized “H” in chrome oval) and two headlight assemblies; no tailight is shown.

claims.claim: The items are for a Prado Jeep.
claims.evidence: Witness report does not show vehicle model/year compatibility or part numbers/fitment markings.

claims.claim: The headlights/grille are in working condition.
claims.evidence: No bulbs/ballasts/wiring connectors are visible and no beam/test/operation footage is shown.

claims.claim: The items are available in GRA Ikeja.
claims.evidence: Location is not verifiable from the witness photos.

risks.risk: Wrong vehicle fitment (Honda grille/headlights shown, but seller claims Prado Jeep).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the headlight and grille part numbers/markings (OEM label/sticker) and/or a photo showing the exact vehicle they came from (VIN/plate blurred) plus a fitment check shot.
risks.if_unproven: Price as likely incompatible/returns-risk (worst-case: buyer may not be able to fit).

risks.risk: Headlights may be incomplete or non-functional (no bulbs/ballasts visible; working condition not demonstrated).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the headlights powered on (low/high beam) with the projector lens/DRL/halo behavior visible, plus photos of the rear connector and any ballast/igniter if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working or incomplete (worst-case: needs parts/testing).

risks.risk: Lens/reflector condition unknown (scratches, pitting, fading, moisture/condensation not shown).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both lenses and reflectors under light from multiple angles, including a check for internal fogging/condensation.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average-wear with possible lens/reflector degradation.

risks.risk: Mounting tabs/brackets may be damaged (only general mounting is visible).
risks.proof: Straight-on close-ups of all mounting points/tabs on both headlights and the grille, showing any cracks/bends.
risks.if_unproven: Price as requiring repair/extra parts if mounting is compromised.

risks.risk: Grille condition and badge mounting integrity unknown (cracks/missing slats not shown).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the grille slats and the badge mounting area from front and back, showing any looseness or broken clips.

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the headlight and grille part numbers/markings (OEM labels/stickers) and confirm the exact vehicle make/model/year they fit.
Send a short video showing the headlights switched on (low and high beam) with the projector output visible.
Send close-up photos of lens/reflector surfaces (front and rear) under bright light to check scratches/pitting and any internal moisture.
Send close-up photos of all mounting tabs/brackets for both headlights and the grille badge mounting area (front and back).
Confirm whether a tailight is actually included; if yes, provide photos of the tailight assembly.
response.reason: The witness photos identify Honda grille and headlight assemblies, while the seller claims Prado Jeep and tailight in working condition; without fitment and power-test proof, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
